prompts.portraitPromptA:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art expression atlas for the existing Coalition Chaos web game.
The attached image is the identity and visual-style reference. Create expression variations ONLY for its TOP ROW FOUR CHARACTERS, with identical face identity, hair, glasses, clothes and colours, in a NEW strict 4-column by 4-row square atlas on genuine transparency.
Each row is ONE character; each column is ONE facial state. EXACT rows: row1 Cyril Ramaphosa (dark suit/gold tie); row2 Geordin Hill-Lewis (brown hair, rectangular glasses, blue tie); row3 Julius Malema (red beret/red shirt); row4 Jacob Zuma (bald, spectacles, olive shirt).
EXACT columns in EVERY row: 1 neutral attentive, closed mouth; 2 same neutral pose with eyelids shut for a brief blink; 3 delighted grin and lifted eyebrows after being invited into a coalition; 4 disappointed frown with lowered eyebrows after being removed. Playful, affectionate, equally exaggerated for all parties. Sad must look SAD rather than angry. Never crying.
CRITICAL production constraints: sixteen bust portraits, EXACT 4x4 equal square grid with NO grid lines. Each bust centered in its cell, same head size and shoulder baseline across all four states. The only changes within each row are eyebrows, eyelids, mouth and at most two art pixels of cheek movement. No head rotation, no camera/scale shift. Transparent margin of at least 10% inside EACH cell; no clipped heads. Align eyes to the same height in all columns of a row.
Chunky authentic low-resolution pixel art: visually ~48x48 art pixels per portrait, nearest-neighbour hard pixel clusters, limited shared palette, dark green outlines, no antialiasing, no smooth shading, no gradients. Preserve reference likeness. No words, logos, frames, props, watermark, extra characters or background.

prompts.walkPromptA:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production FULL-BODY WALK-CYCLE SPRITE SHEET, pixel-art political satire game. Reference image provides facial identity/clothes/style for TOP ROW FOUR LEADERS only.
Make a wide 2:1 atlas, EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, 32 equally sized square cells on real transparency. Each row is one character's eight consecutive frames of ONE coherent right-facing walk cycle.
Rows top to bottom: Cyril Ramaphosa dark suit/gold tie; Geordin Hill-Lewis brown hair/glasses navy suit/blue tie; Julius Malema red beret/red shirt/dark trousers; Jacob Zuma bald/glasses olive jacket/dark trousers.
Each character is a charming full-body small game sprite, oversized recognisable head 40% of height, tiny but clearly articulated arms and legs, black shoes. Turn head and body towards screen RIGHT in all frames, slight 3/4 side view. Facial expression mildly disgruntled, as though walking out of coalition negotiations. Same affection for all.
EXACT eight frame sequence across EVERY row: (1) left foot forward heel contact/right foot back; (2) weight down, left planted, right heel rising; (3) right leg passing bent knee, left leg supporting; (4) body high, right leg swinging ahead; (5) right heel forward contact/left foot back; (6) weight down right planted, left heel rising; (7) left bent knee passing right supporting; (8) body high left leg swinging forward to loop into frame1. Arms counter-swing to legs. Real knee bends, planted shoes, small shoulder/head weight shift, jacket hem follows. Make all eight poses visibly distinct. NO skate-gliding, hopping, mirrored duplicate poses or floating busts.
Registration: every figure centered horizontally in its own equal cell; shared floor baseline at 88% cell height; figure height about 75% of cell; feet never below baseline. Natural head rise only 1–2 native pixels. Same scale, head proportions, clothes and palette in all frames. At least 8% empty transparent cell gutters. NO visible grid, labels, text, door, floor, scene, speed lines or shadows.
Authentic chunky 8-bit pixel art drawn as if each character occupies 48x64 native pixels, hard square clusters, dark forest outline, no antialiasing, no smooth illustration. Requested atlas output ideally 2048x1024. Entire transparent area remains truly transparent.

prompts.speakerPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: animation atlas for Madam Speaker, the secretary-bird host of an 8-bit South African coalition game. Attached sheet is the EXACT character to preserve: grey/ivory feathers, orange beak/legs, black crest, round spectacles, dark forest jacket, gavel and papers.
Create a NEW 4-COLUMN x 3-ROW sprite atlas, 12 equal square cells, genuine transparent background. The bird's identity, proportions and colours remain identical. Full-body charming pixel character, 75% cell height, feet baseline88%, centered same size in each cell, at least8% clear gutter. Four contiguous animation drawings per mood:
ROW1 idle: (1) deadpan eyes open and gavel held; (2) eyelids closed blink same pose; (3) eyes open with head tipped slightly and paper hand lifted; (4) paper hand settles back. Minimal motion, consistent pivot.
ROW2 delighted: (1) knees flex/gavel held close anticipation; (2) gavel lifts as eyes brighten; (3) eyes happy grin, wings thrown up in triumph; (4) settles with pleased expression, gavel still up.
ROW3 shocked: (1) startled eyes widen; (2) gasps mouth open, papers fan slightly; (3) glances sideways with raised brow; (4) disappointed deadpan, papers lower.
The animation is in the drawings: articulate wings, eyelids, beak, feather tips and weight; don't merely translate identical birds. Keep the body/feet registered. No characters or props from adjacent frames can touch. Chunky low-resolution 8-bit pixel art as if64x64 native pixels, deliberate hard square clusters, limited16-colour style, no smooth curves/antialiasing/gradients. No captions, text, visible cell boundaries, shadows or backdrop.
prompts.chamberPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: compact 8-bit game background for a character walkout cutscene, council-negotiation room. A SINGLE wide 8:3 landscape scene, designed on a logical 256x96 pixel grid, enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbour pixels. Camera perfectly flat side-on, all foot traffic left-to-right.
Warm cream plaster wall, dark forest green wooden wall panelling, dull brass fittings, a little empty green bench and a small stack of council papers at far LEFT. Wide uncluttered floor strip across bottom, ground line exactly y=82 of96. Very restrained South African civic chamber feeling with NO flags, logos, national symbols or words.
CRITICAL staging: Right side has one LARGE OPEN WOODEN DOORWAY, dark forest frame, blackish interior aperture. Aperture spans x=196 through235, from y=17 through82; doorway threshold on same floor baseline y82. Right wooden door jamb covers x236 through244, strong vertical foreground edge. Door leaf visible swung into darkness on right side of opening. Empty floor fromx50 through196 for walking sprite. Character must be able to walk through dark aperture and be occluded by right jamb. No furniture obstructing walkway. No characters at all.
Pixel-art style: chunky hand-placed-looking square pixel clusters, hard stepped wood edges, limited warm cream/sage/forest/brown/brass palette, simple flat light, subtle tiles on floor, dark outlines, a few charming asymmetries. Clean game scene, no photorealism, smooth illustration, gradients, blur, perspective vanishing point, cast character shadows, speech bubbles, UI or text. Opaque background.
